MSIB 004-26 Quiet Sound Voluntary Slowdown
https://www.pacificarea.uscg.mil/Our-Organization/Northwest-District/District-Staff/dp/dpw/notices/
The Quiet Sound voluntary commercial vessel slowdown in Admiralty Inlet aims to reduce underwater noise in Southern Resident killer whale critical habitat. The 2025-26 slowdown will be in effect starting at 0001 PST on 3 September 2026 and will remain in effect 24 hours per day until 2359 PST on 31 January 2027, at the latest, depending on orca presence. More information can be found at: https://quietsound.org/admiralty-inlet-slowdown.  
When in effect, the slowdown requests all inbound and outbound commercial vessels transiting through the slowdown zone not exceed the following speeds through water when safe and operationally feasible:  
11 knots – General cargo, bulkers and tankers
14.5 knots – Vehicle carriers, cruise ships, and container vesse
